en.text: There are three state structures (unitary, federal, confederal) and two systems of government (parliamentary, presidential). State and government are related but different: the state is broader and lasting, government narrower and changing. Ethiopia moved from monarchy to the Derg to a federal parliamentary republic, each with strengths and limitations.

screens.title: Unit summary
paras: There are three state structures: unitary, federal and confederal.
There are two systems of government: presidential and parliamentary.
State and government are linked but distinct: the state is broader, government narrower.
Ethiopia moved from monarchy to the Derg's military socialist rule to a republican federal system after 1991.
